sample_data.method: API fetch and pre-populated fixture loader
sample_data.reset_instructions: Judges can load or restore initial sample data via the fixture setup interface or reset options on the dashboard.

problem_solving_method: Built a deterministic prediction engine (src/lib/prediction.ts) that calculates maintenance statuses (Overdue, Due soon, Fine) based on fixture case dates, odometer readings, and daily averages, integrated with a React context-driven dynamic UI.

team_members.major_contribution: Frontend Developer responsible for page layouts, UI components, dashboard structures, and navigation flows.
Lead Backend Developer responsible for Firebase integration, prediction algorithm logic, unit test execution, and context management.

major_design_decisions: Deterministic Date Calculation: Decoupled service due-date predictions from system local time to strictly follow the fixture case date.
Real-time Context Sync: Integrated Firebase Firestore directly with React Context to instantly reflect service completion resets across views.
known_limitations: Requires active network connection for initial Firebase sync before local storage fallback activates.
